bear_case.summary: CF's trough-looking multiple (P/E ~8.7 TTM) sits on peak-cycle pricing: Q2 2026 realized price $523/t (+39% YoY) was helped by Iran-conflict supply disruption while volumes fell 15%. If the geopolitical premium fades or US gas rises, earnings mean-revert sharply; a low P/E on peak earnings is a classic commodity value trap.
